price_reference.note: Market capitalization is calculated from the retained filing-based ADS denominator rather than copied from a vendor.

model_treatment: Retain 2026-09-06 Bear/Base/Bull economic scenarios for comparability. Synchronize price and reverse expectations; do not rewrite terminal economics merely because Q2 and August growth were strong.

bear.narrative: Leading-edge growth normalizes, pricing and utilization soften, overseas capacity dilutes returns and mature owner margin settles near 18%. This normal operating Bear does not substitute for a Taiwan geopolitical catastrophe scenario.

base.narrative: TSMC remains the leading foundry, year-1 revenue is US$185B, owner margin rises from 25% to 27%, growth normalizes over a decade and terminal owner cash is valued at 22x.

bull.narrative: AI/HPC, N2/A14 and advanced packaging sustain exceptional growth, pricing and 33% mature owner margin with a 28x terminal multiple.

reverse_expectations.method: Hold retained Base year-1 revenue US$185B, owner-margin path 25%/25.5%/26%/26.5%/27% then 27%, 22x terminal multiple and 9% required return; solve one constant revenue growth rate for years 2-10 that matches the September 10 price.
reverse_expectations.interpretation: About 15.01% annual revenue growth for nine years after a US$185B year-1 base is demanding. It is not demonstrably impossible given current AI/HPC demand and management's medium-term growth framework, but the price remains materially above retained Base and therefore offers poor expectation-gap protection.

two_state_price_position.note: Algebraic price location only; not an estimated probability.

ttm_cash_diagnostics.note: Translated ratios are diagnostics only. OCF-PPE is not normalized owner FCF during the current global capex wave.

geopolitical_overlay.description: A blockade, conflict or loss of access to Taiwan production/assets can dominate ordinary cash-flow valuation. Overseas fabs improve resilience but do not yet replicate the full Taiwan leading-edge ecosystem.
geopolitical_overlay.treatment: Maintain permanent-loss and concentration veto investigations rather than applying an arbitrary probability haircut that would imply false precision.

valuation_conclusion: At US$427.18, the ADR trades roughly 38% above retained Base value, or Base is about 27% below price. Operational evidence is stronger than in the prior checkpoint, but expectation gap remains weak and new-capital/geographic gates remain open. No buy authorization.
